headline: ZOZO reported exposure affecting 15.18 million ZOZOTOWN members and 13.93 million WEAR members, with possible overlap; Peach Aviation reported nearly 9 million affected records. CNN reported an apparent intrusion into the FBI’s national crime database, but the agency has not publicly confirmed a breach.

incidents.what: ZOZO confirmed customer data exposure through KARTE. The ZOZOTOWN and WEAR counts may overlap; passwords and payment cards were not affected.
Peach disclosed that an October intrusion at email vendor Yumirulink affected customer records. Passport and card information was not involved.
Norway’s security authority said attackers exploited Azure API Management at Equinor and other organizations. It said the flaw had been fixed.
incidents.scale: Confirmed exploitation; no production impact reported at Equinor

incidents.what: Sales after a deployer-account compromise drove XMR1 down to about $1. Wagyu attributed the compromise to its hosting provider; the link has not been independently established.
incidents.scale: About $13.5M in sales, not a new loss this run

incidents.what: Bell disclosed theft of enterprise customer data. It did not disclose the initial access method or a victim count.
Reuters relayed CNN’s report of an investigation into apparent unauthorized access to the national crime database and said the FBI did not respond to its request for comment.
Illinois disclosed an investigation into an apparent cyberattack at Algonquin Dam. The dam remained operational, and officials have not confirmed a compromise.
The transcription provider blocked public access to cloud storage containing customer audio and transcripts after TechCrunch alerted it.
incidents.scale: No verified download or victim count

incidents.what: Kurly reported that stolen credentials were used to access its systems and expose personal data belonging to participants in its affiliate program.
incidents.scale: 10,699 program participants; two other membership IDs

incidents.what: The operator said it took its service offline as a precaution after a cyberattack. Other FDJ United sites were also affected.
Arkham traced new movement of funds from the October 7 wallet theft linked to reseller CryptoBilis. It did not report a new exploit or additional losses.
RIKEN published an updated scope assessment and asked potentially affected users to revoke and replace credentials found on the supercomputer.
